what_happened: The operator accepted the reading for job 20261029-084645-sza7 even though it moved one of the request's acceptance items into a follow-up job. The job then passed its checks and the verifier, but it was rejected because of that split. The run cost about $1.90 and 45 minutes. The operator logged it as a mistake. A follow-up (20261029-111121-fzx0) was queued to add a coverage check at the reading stage.
cause: Nothing at the reading stage compares the reading with the request's acceptance bullets. Each bullet should be either covered by a criterion or explicitly excluded, but the stage never checks this. A deferral that sounds sensible therefore passes review. Only the final verdict notices that the reading no longer matches the request, after the full cost has been spent.
prevention: Add a coverage check to reading acceptance. It extracts the request's acceptance bullets and requires every one to map to at least one reading criterion. A reading that defers, drops or narrows a bullet is refused, unless the request itself allows the split. The check runs before the planning and producer stages are dispatched.
proposed_request: Add a check at the reading stage that compares a request's acceptance bullets with the accepted reading's criteria. Outcome: a reading is refused, with the uncovered bullet named, when any acceptance bullet in the request has no matching criterion in the reading. This includes a bullet the reading moves to a follow-up job. The refusal is lifted only when the request itself states that the split is allowed. Acceptance: (1) a test with a request of three acceptance bullets and a reading that covers two refuses the reading and names the third bullet. (2) A reading that covers all three is accepted. (3) A reading that defers a bullet to a follow-up is refused unless the request allows the split. (4) The check runs before planning is dispatched, so a refused reading costs no producer or verifier spend. (5) Replay the check against past real requests and their accepted readings, and report how many it would have refused.
